name: Dante AI Echo
author: danteai

sections.description:
Deploy your Dante AI Echo agent on WordPress with a single click.

Dante AI Echo lets you build a smart, human-sounding AI agent trained on your own content, then add it to your WordPress site as a friendly chat widget. It answers questions, guides visitors, and captures leads around the clock.

Build and train your agent in the Dante AI dashboard, generate an API key, connect it here, and pick which agent to deploy. The chat widget goes live on your site instantly.

Key features

  • Quick setup – Connect your account and deploy an agent in minutes
  • Choose any agent – Pick from all the agents in your workspace
  • Live widget – The Echo chat widget appears automatically on your front end
  • Performance dashboard – See conversations, resolution rate, CSAT, and credit usage at a glance
  • Domain-aware – The plugin warns you if your site isn’t on the agent’s allowed-domains list
  • Mobile friendly – The widget looks great on phones, tablets, and desktops

How it works

  1. Create a free Dante AI account at dante-ai.com
  2. Build and train an agent on your content
  3. Generate an API key (Integrations -> API keys)
  4. Paste the key into the plugin’s Settings page
  5. Select your agent – the widget goes live automatically

Data and privacy

  • You stay in control – conversations belong to you and are visible only in your Dante AI dashboard
  • No personal information is collected unless a visitor voluntarily provides it
  • Conversations are processed and stored securely on Dante AI servers
  • Disable the widget any time from your WordPress admin

For more details, see our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins -> Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for Dante AI Echo and click Install Now
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Click Dante AI Echo in your admin menu
  5. Follow the guided setup to connect your account and deploy your agent
sections.faq:
Do I need a Dante AI account?

Yes. Sign up for free at dante-ai.com.

Which API key do I use?

Any Dante AI API key generated under Integrations -> API keys works, including the WordPress API key and the Dante API key.

My widget isn’t showing on the site. Why?

Make sure your site’s domain is in the agent’s allowed-domains list in the Dante AI dashboard. The plugin’s Settings page warns you when it isn’t. Also confirm you selected and deployed an agent.

Can I change how the widget looks?

Yes – the widget’s appearance, welcome message, and personality are all configured on the agent in your Dante AI dashboard.

Does the widget work on mobile?

Absolutely. It is fully responsive.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 (July 6, 2026)

  • First release for the Dante AI Echo platform
  • Connect with a Dante AI API key and select an agent to deploy
  • Injects the Echo widget (embed.js) on your site’s front end
  • Dashboard with live agent insights (conversations, resolution rate, CSAT, credits)
  • Warns when your site domain is missing from the agent’s allowed domains
